turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to remember the exact scoring formula we agreed on for SIRA last month. Was it Score = BM25(Q0) + omega * BM25(Q_expected)?
I don't have that specific detail in my current memory, Alan. Would you like me to note it down for future reference?
Actually, let me correct that. It's actually Score = BM25(Q0) + omega * BM25(Q_query). We changed the term from Q_expected to Q_query.
Noted. I've updated the SIRA architecture notes to reflect the Q_query term.
Great. Also, did you see the weather forecast for the weekend? It looks like rain again.
Yes, it is predicted to be rainy. You might want to bring an umbrella if you're going out.
Will do. I also ordered a new mechanical keyboard today, should arrive Tuesday.
Enjoy the new setup! Let me know if you need help with any configuration files.
Lloyd, quick update on SIRA. We reverted the change from last month. The architecture is back to using Q_expected.
Understood. So the scoring function is no longer using Q_query?
Correct. The current formula is Score = BM25(Q0) + omega * BM25(Q_expected).
I have updated the records to reflect that Q_expected is the current standard.
Thanks. I also fixed that bug in the login module we discussed yesterday.
Good to hear. That should reduce the support tickets significantly.
Yeah. I'm grabbing lunch now, probably just a sandwich.
